humanFeedback.ratingBoundary: This is direct qualitative user feedback, not a blinded Bare-versus-Core M5 score or a task-based acceptance test of joeness-setup.

limitations: The first two CLI checks preceded project Apply; the third fresh CLI check followed Apply. The check proves start-context instruction delivery in this CLI surface, not every future session or project.
The applied connection was deliberately detached after the release contract failure; the original repository AGENTS bytes were restored.
The new desktop-app chat was created separately in the saved test project. One successful fresh chat does not establish reliability across all projects, app restarts, or model versions.
No human comprehension or blind Bare-versus-Core usefulness score was collected in this run.
